  Add to `tests/hook.test.ts`:

  ```ts
  test("rejects invalid config", () => {
    assert.throws(() => validateHookConfig({ command: 42 }), /invalid hook config/);
  });
  ```

  ```ts
  export function validateHookConfig(config: unknown): void {
    if (typeof config !== "object" || config === null || typeof (config as { command?: unknown }).command !== "string") {
      throw new Error("invalid hook config");
    }
  }
  ```

  Expected: PASS, including `rejects invalid config`. This also depends on resolving the base failure in the Open Questions row.
